note: PIT snapshots of today's limit-up candidates. Redis Q2 px/pc rounded to the board price is primary; WenCai is a single low-frequency close confirmation/fallback. Q2 has no verified seal amount, so seal_amount remains null unless WenCai supplies a date-matched amount with a verified unit. ST name unavailable is explicit and never treated as NON_ST.

as_of.note: Asia/Shanghai sample time; source timestamps after this time are excluded.

pct.note: Q2 px/pc change or date-matched WenCai value.

limit_up.note: Member matched the board-rounded limit price or the dated WenCai limit-up query.

limit_price.note: Board limit rounded half-up to one cent; null for WenCai-only fallback.

seal_amount.all_null_reason: Q2 has no verified seal-amount field; WenCai amount is included only when its date suffix and unit are verified.

first_limit_time.all_null_reason: Q2 does not provide this field; WenCai may omit it.

final_limit_time.all_null_reason: Q2 does not provide this field; WenCai may omit it.

open_count.all_null_reason: Q2 does not provide this field; WenCai may omit it.

source_ts.all_null_reason: WenCai-only rows do not expose a quote timestamp.

st_status.note: Never defaults to NON_ST when the name map is missing.

redis_phase.all_null_reason: WenCai-only fallback has no Q2 phase.

wencai_confirmed.note: True when the WenCai close query returned the member.
